messages:
Anya: Quick proposal  run a 2-week sprintlet to improve postmortem follow-up closure velocity. Minimal template + 15m weekly huddle + bot digest + 72h remediation-claim rule. Start Monday?
Sam: Yes, keep it minimal. I can add a saved JQL and a bot digest.
Jordan: Strong +1 to explicit remediation_owner. Last time IC and owner blurred. Make remediation_owner required in postmortem doc.
Anya: Tiny template (one-liner fields):
- action_id: SV-200
- remediation_owner: @Sam
- created_by: @Anya
- created_ts: 2026-04-01
- due_date: 2026-04-08
- priority: P2
- status: open/blocked/done
- validation: 7d post-deploy error rate < 0.1%
- recurrence_flag: true/false
- linked_ticket: https://rwd/jira/SV-200
- notes: one-line blocker
Lee: Add validation_window and a "relationship" tag (SLO/billing/customer). Also add triage_rank = priority + recurrence + SLO impact.
Maria: I'll run a 15-min owners-only closure huddle Mon 11am for two weeks. Keeps it short and focused.
Sam: I'll create saved JQL: `project = SV AND status != Done AND due_date < now()` and wire the weekly digest to #eng-oncall.
Jordan: Metrics I'll track: closure_velocity (actions_closed/week), median_time_to_close, percent_recurrence. Will build a small dashboard.
Anya: Policy: remediation_owner must be claimed within 72h of postmortem publish or auto-escalate to oncall lead.
Sam: Automation: incident-bot will create followup tasks from postmortem items, set owner if present, otherwise mark unassigned and ping #eng-oncall. Low lift.
incident-bot: FYI: 3 followups older than 14 days (SV-172, SV-178, SV-182).
Lee: Small habit: when closing an action include a 1-line "how verified" sentence. Makes closure objective.
Maria: Calendar invites sent for Mon 11am for the pilot. Owners get auto-ping when assigned.
Jordan: I'll share a starter dashboard link by Friday.
Sam: I'll post bot config + saved JQL tomorrow.
Anya: Pilot owners: Sam (automation), Jordan (metrics), Maria (huddle). I'll manage 72h escalation enforcement. Start 2026-04-06, review 2026-04-20.
Lee: If recurrence_flag=true, tag the postmortem and schedule a 30-day pattern review.
Anya: Goal: faster closures, clearer ownership, and earlier detection of recurring patterns. I'll post the final template + links in #eng-oncall after updates.
Maria: :white_check_mark:
Sam: :rocket:
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: followup sprintlet starts 2026-04-06.
Anya: Closing thread; will reopen with templates/links.
